description.value: Panino Mio is a North Burnaby Italian sandwich shop bringing award-winning panini from La Grotta Del Formaggio to Hastings Street, located next to Glenburn Ice Cream. The menu features a wide selection of pressed Italian sandwiches with specialty cured meats, imported cheeses, and house-made pesto, alongside cannoli, biscotti, and Italian sodas. Vancouver Magazine named it a top sandwich destination in Vancouver.
